questionTitle: Has the tribunal previously determined the rent for your tenancy?

previousTribunalCaseReference.label: What was the tribunal’s case reference number for the previous determination? (optional)
previousTribunalCaseReference.hint: It’s the 18-digit reference on any letter from the tribunal in your last tenancy determination application - for example, ‘LON/00AD/SMO/2023/0001’

tribunalPreviouslyDeterminedRent.required: Select whether the tribunal has previously determined the rent for your tenancy

previousTribunalCaseReference.invalid: Case reference number must be in the format 'LON/00AD/SMO/2023/0001'
